freeze_note: Frozen 2026-09-26. prompt_sha256 and fewshot_sha256 are of those files. sha256 is of this plan with the sha256 field set to null (canonical JSON, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, trailing newline). Do not edit; if a change is needed write plan_v1.json and log the reason.
scoring: Reuse v3/scripts/s6_eval.py classifiers and numeric metrics. No new gold text for the 60 pending_human rows. Class-level scoring only on those rows.
verdict_wording: Non-significant results: 'no significant difference detected' plus the CI. Never 'equivalent' or bare 'no difference'. For expected-null numeric tests (P4c): 'no loss detected' plus the CI.

prompt.misspell_rule: If a crop name is misspelled but clearly matches exactly one crop in the table, use that crop and state which crop you took it to be. If it could match more than one crop, or none, ask.
prompt.parser_check: v4_work/results/stage8b/parser_check.json — PASS: en gold, bn gold, en P template, bn P template all extract net_mm=1.48 and liters=1089.0
prompt.review_point: P includes the 29-row Kc table from kc_values_hybrid.csv, not only a lookup instruction. That makes P2 a real test of instruction vs weights. If the table should be dropped, say so before freeze.

fewshot.application: Chat: system=P (or P prepended to first user turn if the tokenizer rejects/drops system), then the three (user, assistant) pairs in the order numeric / abstain / missing-input, then the test question as user. Training and the existing 21 arms used no system turn (s2b_render_train.py). The system turn plus few-shots are a new prompt shape; that is the point of the prompted baseline.

chat_template.construction: system=P then (user,assistant)×3 then user=test; if system rejected or dropped, P prepended to first user turn
chat_template.inference_note: Prompt alone is 1676–2248 tokens. Stage 6 inference default INFER_MAX_SEQ_LEN=2048 is too small for phi35_mini bn (2248) before any new tokens. Stage 8B must raise max_seq_length to at least 3072 (prompt + 512 new). Do not truncate P or the few-shots.

seed abstain already scored.note: easy OOD probe used in Stage 6/8; not in the 60

entry_checks.qtype_matches_category: 40 out_of_domain rows are qtype=abstain; 20 conflicting_values rows are qtype=clarify. Matches THESIS_MASTER_CONTEXT §4.

arms.new_arms_eval_note: Run each new prompted arm on all 422 hardened test rows. PRIMARY/DESCRIPTIVE tests use only the subsets listed below. Factual and abstain results for the prompted arms are DESCRIPTIVE (report rates/CIs; no Holm).
arms.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens 512, 4-bit base weights, same as Stage 6 (except max_seq_length raised for the long prompt; see chat_template.inference_note)

hardware_check.sampling: seed 42, stratified by qtype and lang, from rows already predicted by llama31_8b_seed42
hardware_check.decoding: same as Stage 6 (greedy, max_new_tokens 512, same batch size)
hardware_check.pass_rule: identical classification and exact_0.1 on all 50 rows, and ≥90% of outputs byte-identical to the saved generations; else stop and report

multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni across PRIMARY tests within each holm_family. DESCRIPTIVE: CI only, no p.

outcome_meanings.O1_FT_still_abstains: Abstention transfers from the easy seed probe to hard adversarial OOD, or at least does not collapse.
outcome_meanings.O1_FT_abstains_less: Fine-tuning may have narrowed refusal. Report it. Does not by itself undo the clarify finding.
outcome_meanings.O2_easy_higher: The published 100% abstain figure is an easy-probe result (viva Q10). Hard OOD is the number to quote beside it.
outcome_meanings.O2_no_gap: The easy probe was not easier. Strengthens the abstention claim.
outcome_meanings.O3: No policy gold. Descriptive only. Do not score accuracy.
outcome_meanings.P1_P_helps_base: An instruction is enough to cut invention on the base model.
outcome_meanings.P1_P_fails_on_base: The base model does not follow the ask instruction. Weak prompted baseline.
outcome_meanings.P2_FT_beats_P: Numeric gains from fine-tuning are not just 'the model was never told the rules'.
outcome_meanings.P2_P_matches_FT: A prompt with the table is enough for the arithmetic. Fine-tuning's numeric headline is instruction-equivalent on this testbed.
outcome_meanings.P3_P_invents_less_than_FT: An instructed base is safer on missing inputs than a fine-tuned model with no instruction. Supports the title.
outcome_meanings.P3_FT_invents_less_or_equal: Standard FT is not worse than an instructed base on invention. Weakens the 'FT creates the failure' reading; keep the form-of-error (A7/P6) argument.
outcome_meanings.P4_P_helps_FT: The instruction still works after fine-tuning. A deployed FT system needs the instruction (and should be tested with it).
outcome_meanings.P4_P_fails_on_FT: Fine-tuning overrides an explicit instruction to ask. Strongest support for the title.
outcome_meanings.P4c_no_loss: The ask instruction does not cost numeric accuracy on complete inputs. Report as 'no loss detected' + CI if ns.
outcome_meanings.P4c_loss: The instruction harms numeric accuracy. Qualify any P4a/P4b gains.
outcome_meanings.P5_CL_beats_P: Three hundred targeted examples teach more than the prompt. Clarify training is not redundant.
outcome_meanings.P5_P_matches_CL: The prompt is enough; the 300 examples are not required for this testbed.
outcome_meanings.P6: Descriptive. Use to say whether prompted arms still produce complete unhedged invented volumes.
outcome_meanings.P7_no_overask: Prompted arms do not ask on complete numeric questions. P1/P3/P4/P5 gains are not an artefact of blanket asking.
outcome_meanings.P7_overask: A prompted arm asks on complete inputs. Read its gains in P1/P3/P4/P5 against this over-asking rate; do not treat clarify gains as unqualified.
